snippet.title: Hamster Hustle Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3597930/Hamster_Hustle/

Play various playground games as hamsters in this silly online party game. Feel the adrenaline as you outrun taggers, push your way to the top in king of the hill, express yourself with the customizer, and goof off between games. Hamster Hustle is a perfect game for game nights, streaming, casual competition, or if you ever just want to laugh.

Check us out on Steam!
